diagnostics.zero_denominator_policy: all rates/means are null when their explicit denominator is zero; zero_trigger remains true

feature_contract.candidate_event: classification=DELTA_APPLIED, top_changed=true, and non-null snapshot_epoch; snapshots/reconnect anchors excluded
feature_contract.quote_velocity: current microprice (mid fallback) minus effective quote at or before decision_t_us-1s
feature_contract.quote_velocity_epoch_rule: past quote and decision must share snapshot_epoch

model.sport_lock_rule: TRAIN-screened candidate allowlist intersect sports with at least 100 feature-eligible TRAIN decisions

resource_contract.partitioning: one L2 hash bucket plus congruent trade hash buckets per query
